pull_requests.title: Document remaining native context audit and offline edge evidence
pull_requests.head: 912ec129f084d412242c8d04e8b42b428ff9f1e6
pull_requests.body:
Completes the feasible static/offline investigation in `docs/research/remaining-native-context-audit-prompt.md` against main `612dd99b5a5442dd973f975a71abd91920b8a4fe` and the pinned Essential DLL. The addendum reconstructs the complete age/gender/archetype classifiers, traces continuity candidates and PR provider/cache semantics, and specifies hydration completion and late-enrichment boundaries. It preserves the settled PR #2 `old -> older` behavior.

The investigation finds a latent accepted-input defect: stock integration flattening can promote nonempty private `identity.gender` into core gender before OpenAI voice assignment. The inspected PR bridge omits that field, so live occurrence is not claimed. A proposed OpenAI guard and unapplied diff are documented separately; no production voice implementation changes are included. The report also distinguishes server schema support from actual bridge emission, and records native serializer omissions of model/archetype strings.

Validation:
- 168 baseline tests passed; unchanged candidate build passed with 25 AST edits.
- 2,827 ASCII inputs passed through the pinned classifier IL graphs.
- Six offline real-code OpenAI cases passed: unknown actor, accepted-input counterexample/VM guard, delayed and omitted PR, retry/forceNew, and default singleton replacement.
- Metadata reader and observational handle probe compile; proposed diff passes both working-tree and index applicability checks without application.
- Changes are confined to research documentation, evidence and investigation-only tools.

Actual GTA handle lifetime/reuse, streaming/persistence sequences, unavailable LSPDFR modelAge/persona internals, and live PR timing remain explicitly UNKNOWN. No game actions, real API calls or private record logging occurred. The bounded observational probe and runbook are included, compile-tested but not installed or run. The report contains all 13 required sections, pinned provenance, normalized IL, source boundaries and offline logs.

pull_requests.title: Align character-aware voices with audited native demographics
pull_requests.head: f33c1f7d2a1620c4ce643d6aa3f2ab831d416a28
pull_requests.body:
Follow-up to #1 based on the two native-context investigations and the consolidated Hotfix #3 runtime audit.

## What changed

- Treat the exact audited Essential Hotfix #3 `AgeRange` vocabulary as a first-class contract:
  - `young -> young`
  - `middle-aged -> mature`
  - `old -> older`
  - `unknown -> unknown`
- Fix the proven regression where native `AgeRange = "old"` was silently reduced to `unknown`.
- Add regression coverage for every exact native Gender and AgeRange value.
- Preserve the broader defensive parser for numeric/future/integration-provided values.
- Document the audited hydration and integration boundaries:
  - core Gender/AgeRange are native and available before supported first-turn voice assignment;
  - integration enrichment occurs after core actor classification;
  - PR/LSPDFR richer demographics are intentionally not promoted into voice matching yet.
- Document the audited identity limitation:
  - native `PedId` is the current `Rage.PoolHandle` string;
  - `pedId + sessionNonce` remains the intended session-level identity contract;
  - hard replacement sessions may select a different voice, while same-session retries/segments remain stable.

## What this deliberately does not change

- No durable identity redesign.
- No use of Policing Redefined `modelAge`, birthday, or other private/integration-specific records.
- No session-recovery persistence redesign.
- No scratch audit workflows are merged into production.

Those areas remain characterization work in `docs/research/remaining-native-context-audit-prompt.md`.

## Evidence

See:
- `docs/research/character-aware-native-runtime-audit.md`
- `docs/research/remaining-native-context-audit-prompt.md`

The native-old parser fix was independently proven on the audit branch before being converted into normal product regression tests here.

## Validation

- Focused `actorVoiceTraits` regression suite for this patch: **8 passed, 0 failed**.
- The merged #1 baseline had already passed the repository-wide offline gate: **164 tests, 0 failures**, plus the pinned 25-patch candidate build.
- There are currently no workflow files on `main`, so opening this PR did **not** automatically rerun the full candidate suite. Full-suite/build validation should still be run before treating this follow-up as equivalent to the prior 164-test gate.

pull_requests.title: Add character-aware NPC voice assignment
pull_requests.head: 7dcd4d5283595369917e234f2c42c3b9c146eba2
pull_requests.body:
## Goal

Make OpenAI TTS voice assignment use the demographic context Essential already hydrates for each NPC, while preserving deterministic per-session identity and the legacy E2 rollback path.

## What changes

- normalize actor `gender` and `ageRange` into bounded voice traits
- add fail-closed `speechVoiceProfiles` configuration
- add `character-aware-session` assignment mode
- prefer gender-compatible and age-appropriate configured voices
- deterministically break ties with native ped/session identity
- freeze the selected voice for the native session and all E6 segments/retries
- add bounded demographic-aware TTS acting instructions without copying persona/context text
- pass hydrated actor context into the existing voice resolver
- add privacy-safe voice selection telemetry
- keep `deterministic-session` as a v1-compatible rollback mode
- update example configuration and documentation
- add parser, resolver, config, and connection/session regression coverage

## Validation

- full repository offline suite: **164 passed, 0 failed**
- pinned candidate build: **success**
- source-pinned patch count: **25**
- built launcher SHA-256: `0443800cf148f10baa58558f106baa1e97e6edc2d227c0d48cf8fef15c457ed9`
- GitHub-hosted validation: https://github.com/ComradeGenosse/LSA-Enhanced-essential-fork/actions/runs/36948145647
- focused parser/config/resolver/session tests are included in the normal offline suite
- the temporary validation workflow was removed after the successful run and is not part of the feature diff

## Remaining physical gate

The final subjective voice calibration and real GTA playback audition still require the GTA machine; no DLL/protocol change is involved.

Real Xi overrides listener with Ps; real RP and Ba authorize player-only audio. Network and native endpoints are synthetic.
Current real stock tb/rb functions do not orchestrate a conversation.

Current bridge checks current actor and resolver state, without comparing the supplied turn snapshot reference mapping. Native provider reference reassignment frequency is not characterized by this fixture.

Real BK uses global A.context.world. ET is a capture double; real special-turn M4 world is separate and Xn does not propagate it into the OpenAI context. No physical wrong-street observation is claimed.
